'''DarthDeckBuilder Jedi and Politicians''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[DarthDeckBuilder]]
* '''Published:''' 22 November 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Coruscant: Docking Bay|Cor-L-coruscantdockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Coruscant: Docking Bay
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor Coruscant Docking Bay DarthDeckBui JediandP.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck is based on, obviously, Jedi and Politicians. I thought this was funny because as you may remember Jedi don't like politicians.

== Strategy ==

The plan is to play Galactic Senate as your starting location then play Speak With the Jedi Council as your starting interrupt.
